description: Convert a value between units of length, mass, temperature, pressure, data size, volume, speed, time or area. Accepts symbols or full names (km, kilometers, lb, pounds, °F, fahrenheit). Returns the rounded result, the exact factor and the page that documents the definition. Local computation, no API key needed.

from.description: Source unit, e.g. km, lb, °F, MB, cup

to.description: Target unit, e.g. mi, kg, °C, GB, mL

name: convert_unit
